abstract: CONTEXT: There are no reports in the literature of massive deep venous thrombosis (DVT) associated with cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide (BEP) cancer treatment. CASE REPORT: The patient was a 18-year-old adolescent with a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the right testicle, with the presence of pulmonary, liver, and massive retroperitoneal metastases. Following radical orchiectomy, the patient started chemotherapy according to the BEP protocol (without routine prophylaxis for DVT). On day 4 of the first cycle, massive DVT was diagnosed, extending from both popliteal veins up to the thoracic segment of the inferior vena cava. Thrombolytic therapy with streptokinase was immediately started. On day 2 of thrombolytic therapy, the patient developed acute renal failure, due to extension of the thrombosis to the renal veins. Streptokinase was continued for six days and the outcome was remarkably favorable.
abstract_ja: 背景：BEP療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）による癌治療に伴う大量の深部静脈血栓症（DVT）の文献報告はない。症例報告：18歳の若年男性で、右精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有し、肺・肝臓・巨大な後腹膜転移を伴っていた。根治的精巣摘除術後、予防的抗凝固療法を行わずにBEP化学療法を開始した。第1コース4日目に、両側膝窩静脈から胸部の下大静脈まで広がる大量のDVTが診断された。直ちにストレプトキナーゼによる血栓溶解療法を開始した。血栓溶解療法2日目に血栓が腎静脈に進展し、急性腎不全を発症した。ストレプトキナーゼは6日間継続され、転帰は著明に良好であった。
